entities.summary: Nestoras Kommatos is a Greek former professional basketball player and, as of recently, the team manager for Larisa of the Greek Basket League. During his pro club career, at a height of 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m) tall, he played at the small forward, power forward and center positions.
